title: Harness of Minervini v2 health response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

probe.description: Additionally make one cheap request per probed provider to prove it is reachable; off by default so the default check stays offline.

limitations: Without --probe this checks installed dependencies and local doctrine only; it does not prove that remote providers are reachable.

--probe makes one real request per probed provider (yfinance, ibd-rs-rating, SEC) and reports why an unreachable one failed rather than guessing; Nasdaq's multi-megabyte security master is deliberately not probed.
--as-of stamps the envelope but does not alter dependency readiness.
x-capability-contract.output: Python, doctrine-registry, yfinance, and exact ibd-rs-rating version readiness, plus per-provider reachability when probed.

status_meanings.ok: All required local components are ready, and every probed provider answered.
status_meanings.partial: A required local component is missing or mismatched, or a probed provider is unreachable.

x-capability-contract.summary: Check deterministic runtime readiness without making an investment judgment, and optionally probe whether providers are reachable.
